== Notes ==
* [[Penetrating Attack]]/[[Sundering Attack]] will deal more damage to targets with an [[armor rating]] below 80.
* Power Shot isn't taught by the quest [[Choose Your Secondary Profession (Nightfall quest)|Choose Your Secondary Profession]], it needs to be learned from [[Rakanja]] before starting that quest.
